# Operator Manual

This manual covers the Mark II Power Supply Unit (PSU). It is written for
a technician working alone. See Section 4.2 for the torque values and
Figure 1 for the layout.

The PSU shall be isolated before service. The housing must be earthed at
all times.

## 1.1 Glossary

- **Torque wrench** — a wrench that measures applied torque.
- **PSU** — the Mark II Power Supply Unit.
- **Bleed valve** — the valve that releases residual pressure.
